title: Desk Guide: Compounding by Row Size for an Estate's Elected Pass-Through Rows — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital)
content:
# Compounding by Row Size for an Estate's Elected Pass-Through Rows

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital).** The estate pass-through discount is compounded by the size of the row's gross:

| Gross of the elected row | Compounding | Divisor |
|---|---|---|
| under $100.00 | monthly, at one twelfth of the adjusted rate | one plus one twelfth of the rate, raised to the power of twelve times the horizon |
| at least $100.00 and under $1000.00 | twice a year, at one half of the adjusted rate | one plus one half of the rate, raised to the power of two times the horizon |
| at least $1000.00 | once a year, at the adjusted rate | one plus the rate, raised to the power of the horizon |

The discounted value is the gross divided by the divisor. The gross is the pass-through amount of that allocation year less every general retirement already booked on it, held within the room left under the estate annual cap for the calendar year, rounded to the cent.

## Edges

$99.99 is compounded monthly; $100.00 twice a year; $999.99 twice a year; $1000.00 once a year.

## Worked figures (hypothetical adjusted rate of 4.75 percent, horizon of 8 years)

| Gross | Divisor | Discounted value |
|---|---|---|
| $90.00 | 1.003958 raised to the power 96, which is 1.461188 | $61.59 |
| $720.00 | 1.02375 raised to the power 16, which is 1.455803 | $494.57 |
| $2400.00 | 1.0475 raised to the power 8, which is 1.449547 | $1655.69 |
